name: Cutover Before Backfill Completion
description: New application cutover begins reading status_id while unbackfilled rows remain with status_id IS NULL.
schema_sql:
-- Schema for U3
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INT NOT NULL,
    total_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

phases.name: Expand Schema
phases.description: Add lookup table and status_id column

expand_schema.description: DDL: Create order_statuses lookup table and add orders.status_id column
expand_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_statuses (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(32) UNIQUE NOT NULL); INSERT INTO order_statuses (id, name) VALUES (1, 'pending'), (2, 'paid'), (3, 'shipped'), (4, 'refunded') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_id INT REFERENCES order_statuses(id);

legacy_insert_new_order_99.description: Legacy Application: Insert new order 99 with status 'pending' during migration
legacy_insert_new_order_99.sql: INSERT INTO orders (id, customer_id, total_amount, status) VALUES (99, 1002, 89.50, 'pending') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

backfill_batch_partial.description: DML: Backfill only orders where id < 50 (leaving order 99 unbackfilled)
backfill_batch_partial.sql: UPDATE orders o SET status_id = s.id FROM order_statuses s WHERE o.status = s.name AND o.status_id IS NULL AND o.id < 50;

backfill_orders_all.description: DML: Complete backfill for all remaining rows
backfill_orders_all.sql: UPDATE orders o SET status_id = s.id FROM order_statuses s WHERE o.status = s.name AND o.status_id IS NULL;

new_app_cutover_read_99.description: New Application: Read status of order 99 via status_id FK join
new_app_cutover_read_99.sql: SELECT o.id, os.name AS effective_status FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_statuses os ON o.status_id = os.id WHERE o.id = 99;

invariants.name: Backfill Completeness & Status Integrity Invariant
invariants.description: Returns any orders where status_id is NULL or status_id does not match status text.
invariants.sql: SELECT o.id, o.status AS legacy_status, o.status_id, os.name AS lookup_status FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_statuses os ON o.status_id = os.id WHERE o.status_id IS NULL OR o.status != os.name;
